role: @Observable singleton that holds the in-app language's Locale and .lproj Bundle behind locks (readable from nonisolated code) and bumps an observed revision so SwiftUI re-renders on a language change.
types: LanguageManager: final class (@Observable, @MainActor; nonisolated lock-backed state) — in-app language switching
LanguageManager.Localization: private struct — locale + bundle stored together
state: mem:LanguageManager.localizationBox (one OSAllocatedUnfairLock holding locale + bundle) / revisionBox
ud:AppleLanguages (read in systemLanguage; written via AppLanguage.apply)
toplevel: shared is created lazily via thread-safe static let; revisionBox initial 0.

units.does: Static forwarder to LanguageManager.shared.bundle (registers observation of revision).
Lock-backed Locale: registers observation of revision and returns the locale from localizationBox. Get-only; written together with the bundle by init/setLanguage.
Lock-backed .lproj Bundle: registers observation of revision and returns the bundle from localizationBox. Get-only.
Registers observation and returns the revision counter.
Locale for SwiftUI's \.locale environment (= locale); applied at the app root.
units.entry: SwiftUI: read by EmuquApp root view .environment(\.locale, ...) (EmuquApp.swift:320)

units.does: Right-to-left when the locale's character direction is RTL (Arabic), else left-to-right.
Private init: resolves AppLanguage.current to (Locale, Bundle) and seeds localizationBox with both.
Maps an AppLanguage to (Locale, Bundle): system → systemLanguage(); otherwise Locale(identifier: rawValue) and that .lproj bundle (Bundle.main when missing).

branches.effect: falls back to Bundle.main; otherwise the .lproj bundle

units.does: Reads the device's preferred languages fresh (AppleLanguages through the global domain, else Locale.preferredLanguages), picks the best of the bundle's localizations (excluding Base), and returns its locale and .lproj bundle; keeps Locale.current when the language code matches. Without a matching .lproj the fallback is (Locale(first preferred language) ?? Locale.current, Bundle.main).
reads: ud:AppleLanguages (standard, falls through to global domain)

branches.cond: no preferred localization or no .lproj bundle for it
branches.effect: returns (Locale of the first fresh preferred language, else Locale.current; Bundle.main)

branches.cond: Locale.current has the same language code
branches.effect: returns Locale.current (keeps region); otherwise Locale(identifier: code)

units.does: Applies a language: persists via AppLanguage.apply (AppleLanguages), resolves the new locale and bundle and stores both in one lock acquisition, posts languageDidChangeNotification, then bumps revision inside withMutation so observing views re-render.
Finds <code>.lproj in the main bundle; if absent and the code has a '-' region, tries the base language's .lproj; nil otherwise.

branches.effect: base = code (never nil in practice for components(separatedBy:))

branches.cond: base differs from code and base .lproj exists
